proposals.expected_signal: Improves frozen full-sort NDCG@10 by stabilizing high-order propagation with a contrastive auxiliary that separates ego and propagated views while reducing popularity-dominated oversmoothing.
proposals.failure_mode: Contrastive auxiliary may underweight ranking optimization and produce flatter item scores, yielding no gain or slight regression if residual propagation already preserves enough personalization.
proposals.hypothesis: On ML-1M, the weak baseline signal suggests propagation is not extracting enough discriminative structure. A low-cost intervention is to keep pairwise ranking but add a degree-scaled residual propagation scheme and a light contrastive auxiliary between layer-0 and final embeddings, which should increase personalization
